rules.title: Application screening fee cap and consumer protections
rules.quote: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant. The thirty dollar ($30) application screening fee may be adjusted annually by the landlord or their agent commensurate with an increase in the Consumer Price Index, beginning on January 1, 1998.
rules.summary: Landlords may not charge more than $30 per applicant for an application screening fee, with annual CPI adjustments allowed since 1998.
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to federal or state housing assistance programs with their own deposit and fee regulations.
rules.penalty: Landlord or agent must return any amount of screening fee not used for authorized purposes to the applicant; must refund fee within seven days if application not considered due to multiple concurrent submissions.
